title: Toxicity in CHATGPT: Analyzing Persona-assigned Language Models
reasoning: The paper systematically benchmarks toxicity and bias in ChatGPT outputs, including a specific evaluation component for religious groups. 'Religion' is one of the primary noun categories used for generating entity-conditioned responses (Table 2), and the study tests five specific religious traditions (Christianity, Islam, Hinduism, Buddhism, Judaism) to identify toxic stereotypes and discriminatory biases (Table 14).
